course_info.trial_description:
Welcome to a trial lesson with Teacher Mo!

In the 30-minute trial lesson. It gives us a chance to get to know each other and to understand the students goals plus expectations. 

There will be a short introduction at the beginning of the lesson. Then followed by a brief discussion focused on learning needs. As your tutor I like to understand your goals. The reasons you want to improve your English Skills.  The type of skills you are looking to improve. Including your past experiences with learning English.

Once I have a clear understanding of what you are looking for. A small placement test will be given to allow us to determine your level in that particular skill. This depends on the package you are looking to select. (Whether it is a part of Speaking, Reading, Writing and Listening) .

In our trial lesson you get to understand my teaching method.  It will be explained in detail.  You will also get a chance to see the materials I use that will also be helping you improve your skills in English. I will also give a general overview of what to look forward to so you are able to get an idea of what lessons will look like. 

To end off our lesson, you will be provided with some feedback. I would have briefly assessed your skills.  Then provide you with some suggestions that will also help to improve in your English skills. You will also receive a document that is a "Needs Analysis".  It will also allow me to understand your needs deeply in the case of customizing lessons in the future. 

I look forward to meeting you soon.

pro_course_detail.title: English Foundations : Conversational English
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to speak English fluently but you are not practicing enough? This course right here is for you.

Let me tell you how. These lessons are created for the person that wants to start practicing speaking in English or continue practicing speaking in English. With ease and confidence, there will be interactive lessons and engaging topics. You will get a chance to learn new vocabulary words, practice speaking skills for your daily communication. 

The class focuses on using materials that include reading and discussions. They are picked to help you get started with your learning journey in English. They are fun and easy to understand based on your level. They have real-life examples which you can relate to. You get to develop a strong foundation in English in your own comfort. 

In the lesson the main focus is to help develop your speaking skills for everyday life. To make it easy to create basic sentences to improve how you communicate in English. You get to learn the English names of things and people around you. 

The teaching method is very simple. There will be materials to help you understand the meaning of things. Like pictures, words, functions and activities to help you remember. There will also be speaking discussions. Allowing you to practice the language you have learned. The method is student centered. Ensuring the student understands confidently what they are learning. 

This is your chance now to get started... do not wait too long!

pro_course_detail.title: English Foundations : General English
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you looking to improve your overall skills in English. You have to the right place!

These lessons are designed for students who are looking to improve their overall English skills in Speaking, Listening, Reading and Writing. If you know you need help and improvement in one or more of these areas, these lessons are just for you. 

In these lessons, you can expect to have exercises and activities that focus on all your 4 English skills. If you are looking to improve specific skills we can work on that too as lessons are customized to your needs. 

The materials come in a document with a few pages, the topics are chosen according to your interests and what you like to talk about. They include discussion questions, videos/audios, grammar exercises, vocabulary exercises, reading and writing exercises. 

The focus in these lessons is to improve your general proficiency in English. The lessons have so much value, they keep you engaged throughout whilst still having fun in learning. 

Are your ready to transform your English?

pro_course_detail.title: English Foundations | Grammar and Writing
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you confident in all your other English Skills but still have a hard time with Grammar?

These lessons are here to help you. These lessons focus on improving Grammar Skills, we look at helping you improve in simple phrases, understanding tenses, sentence structure, your writing and spelling skills and understanding parts of speech + more. This is truly beneficial if you are between A2-B2 level.

If you are at an advanced level from C1-C2, we look take a deeper look into focusing idioms and formal language structures.

This course is also really good for Business Students who also are looking to improve their writing skills, spelling skills and learn business idioms/phrases. 

Lessons are going to be customized according to the students needs and therefore we will be using a variety of materials to help understand concepts a lot more better. In our classroom activities, you will also be getting exercises to help with practicing what you are learning. You can also expect to receive homework to ensure you are also practicing at home too. 

In the beginning you will receive a placement test to assess your levels in Grammar and then design a really good plan to help improve your skills.

I hope to see you in these lessons soon!

pro_course_detail.title: English Special : Business English
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you looking to become confidant in your Business English skills? I certainly believe that you can. 

As a business professional you can expect to learn more about business etiquette, how to introduce yourself in professional spaces, having better conversations during small talk and how to add value to your input, ideas and opinion during meetings. 

Lessons are customized to the students needs and we can always plan around your busy schedule. In the classroom, we will be using a series of materials that will help to strengthen you speaking skills, your vocabulary and fluency through discussions, role plays and more.

You can expect to learn more business structures such as phrases, idioms and general workplace vocabulary. If you do work in a specific industry we can also customize lessons to that as well. Then main focus is to allow you to use your Business English skills confidently without hesitation or being unsure. We also get to focus on your reading skills, allowing us to improve fluency using real articles.

Does this sound like what you need to sound more confidently at work? Book your first lesson with me and let's work through your skills, together.

pro_course_detail.title: 🗣️ Conversation-Based Lessons
pro_course_detail.description:
Everyday English Conversations (British & American English)

Improve your fluency with real-life dialogues. Learn common phrases, slang, and pronunciation differences between British and American English.
Master Small Talk & Social Conversations

Learn how to start and maintain conversations naturally. Perfect for travelers, expats, or anyone who wants to sound confident in English.
Business English: Speak Professionally in Any Workplace

Develop workplace communication skills, including email writing, presentations, and professional vocabulary. Choose between British or American business English.
Accent & Pronunciation Training (British vs. American)

Focus on pronunciation, intonation, and accent clarity. Learn the key differences between British and American pronunciation.

pro_course_detail.title: 📚 Structured Grammar & Vocabulary Lessons
pro_course_detail.description:
Master English Grammar (British & American Differences Included!)

Cover essential grammar rules with a focus on practical usage. Learn British vs. American spelling, punctuation, and sentence structure.
Expand Your Vocabulary: Speak More Naturally!

Learn useful words, idioms, and expressions to sound more like a native speaker. Includes topic-based vocabulary (food, travel, business, etc.).
Common Mistakes & How to Fix Them

Avoid errors in grammar, pronunciation, and sentence structure. Learn how to correct common mistakes that English learners make.

pro_course_detail.title: 🎭 Fun & Interactive Lessons
pro_course_detail.description:
Learn English Through Movies, Music, & Pop Culture

Improve your English by analyzing movie dialogues, song lyrics, and pop culture references. Great for intermediate to advanced learners.
Roleplay Lessons: Practice Real-Life Situations
Engage in fun roleplays for real-world scenarios like ordering food, job interviews, or booking a hotel.

pro_course_detail.title: 📖 Exam Preparation & Writing Lessons
pro_course_detail.description:
IELTS & TOEFL Speaking & Writing Coaching

Practice for IELTS & TOEFL exams with structured feedback. Improve fluency, coherence, and pronunciation for higher scores.
Write Like a Native: Emails, Essays, & More

Learn how to write professional emails, essays, and reports in English. Tailored for students and professionals.

teacher_info.teaching_style:
During my lessons, I focus purely on the student's primary needs. I generally have a question-and-answer structure to maximize conversations and assess language skills. 

However, I am flexible and open to trying other methods on students' requests. I generally initiate the conversations and correct grammar and pronunciation throughout the lesson. I also focus on improving the student's vocabulary by incorporating various topics in the conversation and making suggestions on sentence construction.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Speaking Preparation.
pro_course_detail.description: This lesson caters to students who are looking to get a language-level certification with IELTS or other testing platforms. Feedback on the result of the test will be given to the student using the IELTS grading formula.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational Practice. B1-C2 (Let's work on increasing your language level)
pro_course_detail.description:
B1-B2
This lesson focuses on general conversations that will improve the student's spoken English. 
The lesson caters to students with an intermediate level of spoken English. The interests of the student will also be incorporated into the lesson to make it a fun and relatable learning experience. 
These lessons will include more corrections in terms of pronunciation vocabulary, and parts of speech(nouns, pronouns, adjectives, determiners, verbs, adverbs, prepositions, conjunctions, and interjections), all of which make up the grammar when speaking English.
The lesson will focus on key factors that make up the English language, those factors include Grammar, Vocabulary, and Pronunciation. Students can expect valuable feedback on each of these factors.

B2-C2
This lesson focuses on conversational practices that will further improve the student's spoken English. 
The lesson caters to students with an advanced to a proficient level of spoken English. The interests of the student will also be incorporated into the lesson to make it a fun and relatable learning experience. 
These lessons will focus more on advanced communication and the complex use of vocabulary. Students can expect intense corrections on the simplest habitual mistakes such as the use of incorrect suffixes and prefixes, incorrect tenses, and other grammar-related mistakes.
The lesson will focus on key factors that make up the English language, those include Grammar, Vocabulary, and Pronunciation. Students can expect valuable feedback on each of these factors.

pro_course_detail.title: Interview Preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
The purpose of this lesson is to prepare Non-Native English speakers for a Job Interview or Promotion. 

During this lesson, we will go through various common Interview questions and focus on responding to them effectively. The lesson focuses on more than just grammar and language, tone of voice, length of answers, and how to answer trick questions are among the few interview strategies that will be practised during this lesson.

Your specific Job Application or Promotion will be the main focus of the lesson.

teacher_info.teaching_style:
My lessons are 30 minutes to an hour-long. They are divided into 4 sections: 
Reading and comprehension questions and discussion. 

Teaching style - Delegation, it's important for me to encourage my learner's capability and commend their efforts. I find that giving compliments to students when they do well boosts their confidence and encourages them to go beyond the average standard of achievement. 

Discussion - At the end of the lesson I encourage a free conversation based on the topic learnt to assess the student's understanding. At this point, I encourage questions so they get clarity on concepts they might have missed. Overall my students can look forward to having fun while learning.

course_info.trial_description:

For learners that are capable of reading and writing, we will provide fun and mentally challenging activities that will further sharpen your child's skills.


Language and grammar for all - If you need assistance with reading and comprehension, poems, parts of speech, tenses, prepositions, pronunciation etc. We have an array of interesting activities for beginner and advanced students. Our courses aim to improve the way you see and apply the English language in your daily, scholarly and professional environment.  If perhaps you are looking to practice your speaking skills, I am a free-spirited teacher who enjoys listening and learning about new cultures, at your request I will correct your pronunciation and share my thoughts and opinions about the topics we discuss.

pro_course_detail.title: ADULTS -  PRACTISE  HOW TO KEEP GENERAL CONVERSATIONS GOING
pro_course_detail.description:
This package is for students  from level B1 - Proficient.

I am an international relations student who understands the importance of having effective communication skills.
In order to better understand the world and, to establish deeper and more meaningful connections with others, you must ensure that you are heard and understood correctly when you speak moreover, It is also just as vital for you to have good listening and comprehension skills so that you can understand when others speak to you.

In a general conversation class, you can expect to sit back and enjoy a conversation similar to that of  catching up with an old friend.  
Together we will explore amongst a plethora of conversation topics, general issues such as daily routines, current news events , hobbies, personal beliefs and principles, history, mission statements, personal goals, working/holiday/personal/experiences, individuality, realism, equality and sexuality, identity, human rights, education, general knowledge and many more.

Book a trial lesson for just 5$ 
Let's become great conversation partners

pro_course_detail.title: THE POWER OF LITERACY- READING & COMPREHENSION - ADULTS LEVELS (A1- C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
I have lived a thousand lives.
I have witnessed words turn into a thousand worlds right before my eyes. I read. 

A few weeks back I travelled to Kabul, Afghanistan. I felt the impact of the exploding bombs as they obliterated the little hope that I had left that one day, my daughters will be free from laws that aim to keep them in bondage.  

Last night I had dinner with Buddha and we conversed about the meaning of life. He spoke of nirvana and eternal bliss which made me realise just how little I require to be truly happy. 
Once upon a time, I travelled back to the century in 1700.  My name was Nandi and I gave birth to a son, a king who would be known to the world as Shaka. The Zulu man that defeated the British army was armed with nothing but a spear and no shoes on his feet.

Literacy has the power to transform, it transcends boundaries and opens a million portals of possibility, It brings the world and history to us.
Knowledge is infinite, it is power and it is all found in a book. 
Let us cultivate the culture of reading.
Let us dare to walk in the shoes of others
Come along, let's go to places authorities would never let us. 

Join me for a reading session.
New students are welcome to book a trail for $1

pro_course_detail.title: Introductory session
pro_course_detail.description:
The power of words.
It is said; John was a hero, he died fighting for peace. 
The irony, John didn't need a sword to make peace, he needed a pen. 

The founders of democracy and human rights realized that, hence, they established a universal law that states that conflicts will be resolved by courts and treaties.  
Using words as our weapons, we fight raging wars that continue to ravage our societies. 
Poverty, extortion, colonization, disease, these are all wars being fought with a pen.  
We live in an information society that thrives on communication, the exchange of words is what makes the financial industries, religious sectors, educational, entertainment, and many other sectors all possible. 

Through the use of words we have managed to unite mankind,  we are slowly progressing from the barbaric habit of fighting for peace and instead, we are resolving our differences and finding similarities as well as solutions through conversations.    

It is vital to be able to express yourself, especially in this ever-growing digital society.
Let me help, I do proofreading, editing and narrating.
New students, book a trial for $1
